text:
Estimated from the photo, the tray holds:
- Two slices of wholemeal toast: about 150 kcal.
- One fried egg: about 90 kcal.
- A bowl of strawberries: about 25 kcal.
- Roasted mushrooms and two tomato halves: about 60 kcal.
- Two jam portions (apricot and strawberry): about 70 kcal.
- Water: 0 kcal.

Total served is about 395 kcal.

The photo is taken before eating, so leftovers have to be guessed. I assumed the person leaves about 10% of the food, mostly some mushrooms and possibly some jam, which comes to roughly 40 kcal. That leaves about 355 kcal eaten.

For the macronutrients of what is eaten:
- Protein: about 6 g from toast, 6 g from egg, and 3 g from mushrooms, tomato and strawberries, so about 15 g.
- Carbohydrate: about 26 g from toast, 1 g from egg, 6 g from strawberries, 5 g from vegetables and 15 g from jam, so about 50 g after leftovers.
- Fat: about 2 g from toast, 7 g from egg, and 3 g from added cooking oil and spread on the vegetables and toast, so about 12 g.
